text:
kevin (Billing): Heads up — CloudRack vendor invoice finally posted today but dated 2024-04-30. It pushes ~$48,234.56 of usage into Apr month-end deferrals. Need decision: accrue for Apr close or flow into May?

maria (Revenue Ops): Can you paste the invoice lines? Is this commit allocation or pure overage?

kevin (Billing): Short snippet from the invoice below — posted to Drive as well.
```
INV-20240430,usage,commit-allocation,0,0.00
INV-20240430,usage,overage,gpu-hours,48234.56
INV-20240430,tax,vat,0,0.00
```
kevin (Billing): Summary: $48,234.56 usage overage tied to customer batch jobs; vendor invoiced late (banking/payment terms fine). This is a pass-through vendor cost tied to revenue we already recognized under committed pricing.

ajay (RevOps): My vote: accrue the vendor cost in Apr and post a reversing JE in May. That keeps period matching and avoids an expense spike in May when we already budgeted revenue. We'll need an accompanying memo tying the accrual to the invoice receipt date and usage period.

maria (Revenue Ops): If we accrue expense, do we also need to adjust deferred revenue schedules? The customer was on a committed plan — revenue was recognized per schedule already. This is just vendor cost, right?

kevin (Billing): Correct — vendor cost only. We should not touch customer revenue schedules. However, our internal cost of goods sold for Apr will change; that affects gross margin. Need controller sign-off for >$50k but this is under that threshold.

sophie (Controller): I agree with accrual + reversing entry. Two asks before I approve JE: 1) attach the PDF invoice + PO or SOW reference, 2) short one-paragraph memo (cause, amounts, account mapping, proposed JE). Also confirm GL account for accrual — use 6405 (Vendor usage accrual) and clearing 2001 (Accrued liabilities).

kevin (Billing): billing-bot uploaded the invoice and I've attached the PO link in the drive.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-20240430 uploaded to /drive/finance/vendor-invoices/CloudRack/INV-20240430.pdf :paperclip:

kevin (Billing): Per Sophie, will draft memo and JE. Proposed JE:
```
Dr 6405 Vendor usage expense 48,234.56
Cr 2001 Accrued liabilities 48,234.56
```
Reversal on 2024-05-01:
```
Dr 2001 Accrued liabilities 48,234.56
Cr 1010 Cash/Payments 48,234.56
```

ajay (RevOps): I'll prep a reversing JE template and tag Treasury to expect payment in early May.

sophie (Controller): Please include vendor invoice number and vendor remittance date in the memo. If the remittance stretches beyond 60 days, we may need to reclassify — but looks fine now.

maria (Revenue Ops): One operational note — if we keep accruing late vendor invoices, we should track frequency as a metric (vendor invoice lag) so procurement can escalate with the vendor.

kevin (Billing): Good call. I'll add a datapoint to the monthly vendor-lag dashboard.

kevin (Billing): Action items: 1) I will draft memo + JE and post to /drive/finance/journal-drafts by EOD. 2) Ajay will prep reversal template. 3) Sophie to approve the JE once memo & PDF attached. If no objections, I'll file the accrual entry for Apr close.

sophie (Controller): Approved in principle; will formally sign once memo + attachment present.

kevin (Billing): Thanks — tagging for quick review: @sophie @maria @ajay. Aim to close by EOD so Finance can include it in the Apr close pack. :thumbsup:

maria (Revenue Ops): ACK, will review memo when posted.

ajay (RevOps): ACK, will stand up reversal JE.

kevin (Billing): Final note — estimated tax impact is immaterial (no VAT), and this won't change customer invoices. Closing now.
